title: Vaporesso iTank T Vape Tank 2ml
description: The Vaporesso iTank T represents the next generation of sub-ohm tank design, building on the success of the original iTank series with key improvements focused on usability and leak resistance. Designed for Direct-to-Lung (DTL) vapers who prioritise flavour intensity and cloud density, the iTank T is the perfect companion for high-wattage mods like the Armour Ultra. The most significant upgrade in the iTank T is the implementation of a Top Airflow System. By positioning the air intakes at the top of the tank, Vaporesso has created a highly effective barrier against leakage, a common issue in traditional bottom-airflow sub-ohm tanks. The air is channeled down to the coil and back up, ensuring the coil is thoroughly ventilated for a smooth, turbulent-free draw that maximizes vapour production. The tank is compatible with the celebrated GTi Coil platform, including the latest Dual Mesh options. These coils utilise COREX Heating Tech to ensure rapid, even heating of the e-liquid, resulting in accurate flavour reproduction and extended coil lifespan. Refilling is effortless thanks to the top-fill mechanism, allowing you to top up your e-liquid without removing the tank from your mod. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
